application_engine: DF_Medium Bottle Rocket JA21 Web Engine
electron_substitute: VEC1 four-node portable desktop lifecycle substrate + DF0 host-mediated placement + JA21 Optical Instrument shell + selectable WebView2 composition live-web / DF_Medium native-inspection engines
runtime_host: Portable run-in-place WPF presenter; DF node/service boundaries follow substrate/config/ja21_portable_placement.json
window_adapter: Windows WPF optical-instrument presenter using composition-safe live-web overlays
renderer_adapter: selectable: Microsoft Edge WebView2CompositionControl live web; DF_Medium JA21 scene graph native inspection
helper_vm: DF_Small owns portable boot/security/reference guard duties; DF_Medium owns semantic/native inspection; DF_Large owns host/device/live-web boundaries; DF_Xtra_Large owns workspace/snapshot/replay duties

ja_mirror.network: DF_Medium Web Device ABI with bounded Windows/.NET TLS byte-transport primitive
ja_mirror.css_cascade: inside DF_Medium web engine; bounded subset profile
ja_mirror.layout: inside DF_Medium web engine; scene graph emitted to presenter
ja_mirror.images: DF_Medium discovers/resolves image resources; OS image codec primitive presents decoded pixels
ja_mirror.video: Native mode uses OS media primitive for direct media; Live mode uses WebView2 for modern site players/adaptive streaming subject to site/DRM/runtime support.
ja_mirror.site_javascript: isolated/not executed in Native mode; Live mode delegates modern page execution to WebView2

omni_experience.design_system: JA21 Optical Instrument Design System 2.8.0 (host/JA21VirtualBrowser.cs: Ja21Design, Ja21Motion)

limitations: JA21-owned mutable state is redirected to package-local workspace/. OS components outside JA21 are not claimed to be globally prevented from using Windows profile locations.

Exact browser-engine binary reproducibility requires a pinned WebView2 Fixed Version Runtime in runtime/webview2-fixed or workspace/runtime/webview2-fixed; Evergreen fallback may vary by machine/update.
Live web requires the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime plus the pinned SDK adapter; startup can provision the SDK adapter and falls back to Native mode if unavailable.
DRM-protected or site-restricted video remains subject to the installed WebView2/Edge runtime, Windows media/DRM components, network policy and the website itself.
Native inspection remains a bounded JA21/DF_Medium HTML/CSS profile and intentionally isolates arbitrary site JavaScript.
VEC1 lifecycle evidence does not imply a DF fabric execution verdict; strict fabric verification remains a separate explicit control-plane operation.
Addresses on loopback, link-local and private networks are refused by default; set JA21_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOSTS=1 to opt in deliberately.
Dark appearance is an explicit JA21_THEME=dark override in this release; automatic Windows light/dark preference following is not yet claimed.
Windows GUI, real WebView2 overlay composition, HDR, mixed-monitor DPI, and protected-media qualification remain target-machine tests.

vec1_substrate.strict_four_node_execution: All four node containers are vendored and resolvable; execution verdicts remain fail-closed and are not synthesized by the presenter.
vec1_substrate.presenter_writes: sealed electron state + hash-chained ledgers under workspace/state/vec1/

live_web.mode: preferred for http/https when adapter/runtime are available
live_web.engine: package-local fixed WebView2 Runtime when supplied; otherwise installed Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime
live_web.user_data: workspace/state/webview2/ (no AppData fallback in JA21 code)
